Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D fighting game animation sprite sheet. Image1 is SAYO's canonical master drawing; image2 her approved design poster. Preserve exact composed adult woman's face, ornate gathered dark updo with small flower hairpin and hanging ornaments, fitted layered formal black/white kimono with long wide sleeves, embroidered lower fabric, ornate obi and tassels, wrapped ankles and sandals. Preserve the master's weapons: a main OPEN iron war fan (tessen), visible radial ribs and light ink-patterned leaf, held in leading hand; a secondary CLOSED tessen held quietly near waist by other hand. No swords, daggers or spears. Sayo is an educated court adviser: controlled, calculated, poised movement, disciplined hands, calm expression. Not a dancer, not a magician.
Exactly EIGHT complete full-body poses on a PORTRAIT canvas arranged TWO COLUMNS FOUR ROWS in reading order. All face RIGHT in same side/three-quarter game camera. Consistent head/body scale, clothes, face, hairstyle and fan construction. Clear generous transparent gutters between cells, full hairpin, sleeves, robe hem, sandals and fan tips inside each cell. True TRANSPARENT background, monochrome detailed ink illustration, opaque white skin and fabric. No background, floor, shadows, labels, text, grid, effects, flower petals, floating ink marks or motion blur.
Sheet1 GUARD AND WALK. Cels1 and2 canonical composed guard, open main fan held outward at hip/chest height, closed second fan by obi, subtle breath with planted feet. Cels3-8 six sequential phases of measured forward sliding footwork: rear heel softens, leading foot glides right, weight transfers without head bob, trailing foot gathers, small second glide, return to starting stance. Shoulders level, upright torso, tiny controlled knee flexion. Feet visible beneath robe hem. Actual distinct leg/hem positions and slight sleeve follow-through. No exaggerated stride, high knees or seductive pose.

Row1 pose0 beginning a forward sprint, a slight poised lean toward RIGHT and low heel lift; pose1 controlled long gliding step RIGHT, upright head, knees low, feet close to floor, robe following softly. Quiet efficient noblewoman, no aggressive crouched running.
